original_query: Which region of the world accounts for the highest percentage of 2010 revenues?

confirmed.answer_text: North America accounts for ~36% of 2010 revenues.; Europe accounts for ~32% of 2010 revenues.; Asia Pacific accounts for ~18% of 2010 revenues.; Rest of world accounts for ~14% of 2010 revenues.
confirmed.summary: The page illustrates Alcatel-Lucent's global revenue distribution for 2010, showing that North America accounts for 36% of revenues, followed by Europe at 32%, Asia Pacific at 18%, and the Rest of the world at 14%. It also includes a map with locations of business centers and employee nationalities.
key_facts: North America accounts for ~36% of 2010 revenues.
Asia Pacific accounts for ~18% of 2010 revenues.
Rest of world accounts for ~14% of 2010 revenues.
